about_the_game:
Phantom Squad drops you into the chaos of tactical combat, where quick thinking and precise execution are the difference between life and death. Play solo or team up with 2-4 players, navigating brutal missions where every choice counts.

Betrayed and marked KIA, you and your squad are now ghosts. With no orders and no rules, it’s just you, your team and the mission. Survival isn’t a guarantee… it’s earned.

Plan Your Assault

Use voice chat and in-game tools to lay down your plan. Then strike fast, adjust on the fly and be ready to react as the battlefield shifts. The enemy is always watching, always adapting.

Intense Gunfights

When the shooting starts, use every bit of firepower at your disposal. If you miss the target, they won't miss you. One bullet could be the difference between saving a teammate or failing the mission.

Equipment Is A Must

Your squad can rely on more than just firepower. Over 20 specialised gadgets, heartbeat sensors, breaching tools and more, give you the upper hand. You’ll need them to survive.

Main Features

  • Tactical Pre-Planning: Plot your route, mark objectives and coordinate entry points before moving in.

  • Friendly Fire: Stay sharp! Accidental shots can take out teammates, making communication and precision critical.

  • Realistic Combat: Face deadly, precision-based gunfights with no room for mistakes.

  • Specialized Gear: Use a diverse arsenal of gadgets to outsmart, outmanoeuvre and overpower your enemies.

  • Dynamic Maps: Plan your approach in environments that are always shifting, ensuring no two missions are the same.

  • Co-Op Teamwork: Coordinate with up to 3 players, each taking on a unique role to execute the perfect strategy.

No backup. No rules. Just survival. Are you ready?

content_descriptors.notes: Phantom Squad features intense violence, strong language and mature themes. Players engage in realistic tactical combat, including graphic depictions of injury and death. The game explores themes of betrayal, survival and moral ambiguity, with a focus on strategic planning and teamwork under high-stress conditions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2500 or AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GTX 660ti or AMD R9 270 with 2+ GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 600 MB available space

short_description: Phantom Squad is an intense 1-4 player tactical top-down shooter that blends fast-paced combat with real-time strategy.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
